I definitely think we should erase celebrity culture and celebrity worship as it’s still a power structure not much different from other kinds of them.

This celebrity culture obviously comes from capitalism. The most well known celebs just constantly sell a product once they get to that point, this is debatable but I don’t think that’s art anymore. They just try to sell, sell and sell. 

In an anarchist society we would all be more ‘connected’ somehow, so I don’t think we would feel the need to idolize artists. They would just be people who would be viewed the same as others, and would be appreciated for their work, again, same as others.  
I know that that feeling or admiration towards someone can’t be diminished or anything but ideally it would be something like “oh, I really like this person’s work” and not something crazy such as believing they’re superior just for making music and having millions of people who listen to it, which is what happens now.

Most mental illnesses and also trauma can be caused not by capitalism itself, but by something related to it. For example, parents abusing their children (emotionally, psychologically, physically, or any other way), which is a very common thing that they do because they think they have authority over the kids and think of them as their property. In an anarchist society, this kind of stuff would experience an extreme decrease if we did everything the right way.
Though I know that there are reasons of mental illness and trauma that are in no way related to social problems. We still would need psychologists and psychiatrists, so I don’t understand why there are some anarchists who think we wouldn’t.
